adjudication.depicted_input: The available figures show a high-level training/modality overview and downstream performance results, but not the actual Qwen input interfaces for the protein routes.
adjudication.rationale: Figure 1 depicts backbones, training stages, and biological modalities, including proteins and ESM3, but it does not visibly show either listed actual-model-input route: (1) ESM-3 residue embeddings projected and inserted at protein placeholder positions, or (2) the structured protein metadata/text prompt supplied as tokens. Under the atlas rules, a valid crop must show the source object, representation, transformation, or immediate interface for at least one supported route. The remaining candidate figures are performance and ablation plots with no input path. There is therefore no defensible crop or replacement figure.
